sleeping_bag.name: Zip Around Sleeping Bag 20F (-7C)
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current official Zip Around family, normalized to 20F Standard-Medium
sleeping_bag.zipper_spec: full-length 2-way side zipper wrapping around the footbox
sleeping_bag.chamber_construction: vertical upper-body baffles with no sewn-through seams
sleeping_bag.key_features: 20F/-7C Standard-Medium normalized row; 612 g total; 412 g of 900 FP duck down; full-wrap zipper opens flat like a blanket; 30% overstuff; couples can zip compatible newer bags together.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: Zpacks positions the Zip Around as the most versatile hoodless hybrid in its lineup, pairing bag-like enclosure with blanket-like venting and flat-open use.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Warm, comfortable and versatile; opens flat; vents feet; can be worn cape-style in camp; new bags can zip together in pairs.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Ultralight backpacking, bikepacking and users who want one item to cover both quilt-like and bag-like behavior.
sleeping_bag.customization_options: temperature 30F, 20F or 10F; multiple lengths, widths and shell/liner colors
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. User label 'Zpacks 20F Zip Around' maps directly to the current official Zip Around Sleeping Bag family. Row normalized to 20F Standard-Medium. No credible current FR retailer price found.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: This is the closest current official version of the former 'Full Zip' style concept, but the official current naming is Zip Around Sleeping Bag.
sleeping_bag.care_instructions: Store dry; follow Zpacks gear care guidance for shell fabric and down products.
sleeping_bag.faq_important: Any two new Zip Around sleeping bags purchased in November 2024 or later can zip together.
sleeping_bag.compatible_accessories: Zpacks Down Hood; Zpacks roll-top dry bag
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Two year limited warranty against defects in materials or workmanship.
sleeping_bag.official_price_text: Official family page starts at US$499.00; all-black color variants are US$30 lower while sizes last.
